Samir (Partnerships): Quick sync: CipherForge wants marketplace listing + joint blog for their HSM + PKCS#11 BYOK import path. Need tech gating + acceptance tests and embargo plan.
Lena - Security: Gating: FIPS 140-2/3 certs, HSM model attestation, SOC2 Type II, and clear KMS audit trail for key-import and usage.
Diego (Eng): Two supported BYOK flows: 1) JWE-wrapped key via HTTPS (our default); 2) PKCS#11 import for SI partners (requires module info + slot/label mapping). We need module vendor signature and test harness.
Rowan (Legal): Marketplace requires DPA + BYOK addendum that states customer key ownership and liability. Draft will take ~6 business days after we get the technical spec.
Maya (Marketing): We'll schedule a joint webinar and a co-author blog. Need approved partner quote and partner logo SVG.
Diego (Eng): Minimal acceptance tests: - import key via both flows; - perform sign/derive operations from Redwood runtime; - rotate key and verify old keys are revoked; - confirm audit logs show key_id, actor, timestamp.
Diego (Eng): PKCS#11 sample (high level):
```
# load module and list slots (example)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/vendormodule.so --list-slots
# import key
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/vendormodule.so --slot 0 --login --write-object key.bin --type privkey --id 01
```
Lena - Security: We also require tamper-evidence attestation (HSM vendor statement) and a key-wrapping proof if they don't hand us the raw key material.
OncallBot: Note: add requirement for key-usage policy integration (limit usages: sign, no-export) to the checklist.
Samir (Partnerships): Timeline proposal: tech artifacts due 2026-06-02, legal signoff by 2026-06-10, security review done by 2026-06-08, soft listing 2026-06-15, public press 2026-06-22 (embargo lift). Agree?
Rowan (Legal): Sounds ok assuming artifacts arrive on time.
Maya (Marketing): I'll draft the timeline and a 1-pager. Can we get a partner-approved blurb by 2026-06-04?
Diego (Eng): I'll drop the PKCS#11 module validation checklist and small test harness link into /shared/partners/cipherforge-hsm by EOD Fri.
Lena - Security: Add acceptance criteria: log integrity proof (signed logs) and weekly audit export capability.
Samir (Partnerships): Action items: Diego -> harness + module checklist; Lena -> security gating doc; Rowan -> draft DPA addendum; Maya -> co-marketing assets; I'll coordinate partner comms. Weekly check-in Thursdays 10am PT.
OncallBot: Reminder: attach SOC2 report and pen-test to the shared folder when available.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks all — syncing with partner today, will push quote ASAP :rocket:
